# T.I.T.S. triggers

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot has both of its connections to T.I.T.S. working (one to send commands, one to hear hits).

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%tits.host%` | The computer T.I.T.S. runs on |
| `%tits.port%` | The port number it uses |

<small>Type id: `tits.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot was fully connected to T.I.T.S. and one of its two connections drops.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%tits.host%` | The computer T.I.T.S. runs on |
| `%tits.port%` | The port number it uses |

<small>Type id: `tits.disconnected`</small>

## Events connected

Runs when the connection Cuebot uses to hear about hits and triggers from T.I.T.S. comes up.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%tits.host%` | The computer T.I.T.S. runs on |
| `%tits.port%` | The port number it uses |

<small>Type id: `tits.eventsConnected`</small>

## Events disconnected

Runs when the connection Cuebot uses to hear about hits and triggers from T.I.T.S. drops.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%reason%` | Why it dropped |

<small>Type id: `tits.eventsDisconnected`</small>

## Item hit

Runs when a thrown item hits your avatar in T.I.T.S. Great for a reaction sound or a "ouch!" message.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Items** | Only react to these items, typed by name or id. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any item. |
| **T.I.T.S. triggers** | Only react to hits caused by these T.I.T.S. triggers, typed by name or id. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any. |
| **Minimum strength** | Only react to hits at least this strong. Leave empty to react to every hit. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%itemName%` | The name of the item that hit |
| `%itemId%` | The item's id |
| `%triggerName%` | The name of the trigger that threw it |
| `%triggerId%` | The trigger's id |
| `%strength%` | How hard the hit was |
| `%direction.x%` | Hit direction, sideways |
| `%direction.y%` | Hit direction, up or down |
| `%direction.z%` | Hit direction, forwards or backwards |

<small>Type id: `tits.itemHit`</small>

## Trigger activated

Runs when a T.I.T.S. trigger starts (the thing that decides when items get thrown).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **T.I.T.S. triggers** | Only react to these T.I.T.S. triggers, typed by name or id. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%triggerName%` | The name of the trigger |
| `%triggerId%` | The trigger's id |

<small>Type id: `tits.triggerActivated`</small>
